newsitem.title: DUBAI: Gulf trade expects higher Saudi LPG contract price.
newsitem.headline: Gulf trade expects higher Saudi LPG contract price.

text.p: Gulf traders said on Thursday they expect a steep rise in Saudi Aramco's contract price (CP) for November liftings of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG).
Aramco's October propane and butane prices were set at $205 a tonne and traders are expecting the firm to raise prices by at least $20 a tonne because of higher winter demand.
"Market premiums have been strong...Tenders have been going at higher numbers," one Gulf LPG term customer said.
Propane was assessed at $250-$255 a tonne in Thursday.
Aramco increased its propane CP in November 1995 to $180 a tonne from $159 the previous month.
